meta.title: This Country Is Completely Inside Another Country
meta._convention: One scene-spec JSON per script, saved alongside it as <script-name>.scenes.json. Each beat's `duration` is intentionally omitted -- build_video.js fills it in at render time from the ACTUAL measured length of that beat's generated narration WAV.
meta._note: Re-rendering this one (originally Video #4 / Day 2, produced on the paid Higgsfield pipeline) on the local pipeline instead, because the AI-generated footage showed an incorrect flag on screen. The local pipeline renders real country polygons + real flag emoji, so there's no risk of a hallucinated/incorrect flag graphic.

beats.voText: This country has exactly one neighbor. Not because it's small, because that one neighbor completely surrounds it, on every single side.
This is Lesotho, a mountain kingdom sitting entirely inside the borders of South Africa, the only fully enclosed country in Africa.
It's also one of only three countries on Earth completely surrounded by a single other nation, alongside San Marino and Vatican City.
Lesotho sits so high in the mountains that it's the only country on Earth entirely above 1,000 meters in elevation.
That height means Lesotho exports something South Africa doesn't have enough of, water, piped downhill straight into Johannesburg's taps.
One country, one neighbor, completely surrounded, and still exporting the one thing its giant neighbor needs most. Follow for more countries that shouldn't work, but do.
